name: Authenticated source upload stores bytes privately
description: Checks source content is stored only through an authenticated owner-scoped API and the project records the uploaded state.
steps: Create a project with a small HTML file
Wait for the source upload and preflight to finish
expected: The project shows uploaded bytes, detected static hosting target and entrypoint; it remains a draft and is not published.

name: Reject oversized and unsafe source uploads
description: Checks the API rejects invalid paths, oversized file bodies and mismatched byte lengths.
steps: Attempt to create a project with a path traversal filename
Attempt to upload content above the size limit
Attempt to upload bytes not matching the declared size
expected: The API rejects each invalid request without marking a file uploaded.

name: Delete project and associated private source files
description: Checks deleting a project removes its private source objects before deleting metadata.
expected: The project and its source objects are removed, and unrelated account records remain unchanged.

name: Mobile source upload workflow
description: Checks the source upload flow is usable on a narrow screen.
expected: Upload progress is shown and the resulting project card fits the viewport.

name: ZIP preflight clearly reports inspection limits
description: Checks ZIP uploads are not falsely reported as inspected or ready to build before secure extraction exists.
expected: The project reports archive inspection as pending and explicitly states that no build or public deployment was started.
